raw_response:
This chart illustrates the negative log probability for the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, with categories including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, listed in that order. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled as “Negative log probability”, with a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there is a group of six bars, each representing a different fine-tuning dataset. The bars are colored in shades of orange, with one bar in light blue for the “MistralV0.2-Base” model. The bars are grouped by specialty, with each group containing six bars representing the different fine-tuning datasets. The shortest bars are approximately -23.5, and the tallest bars are approximately -22.2. There is no apparent sorting of the bars within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
